bio: An unremarkable Daly City strip mall might not be the most obvious spot to find well-crafted Thai cuisine, but putting appearances aside, this cheery little spot delivers on flavor. During the daytime, you’ll find an assortment of fusion brunch items (for example, a take on chicken and waffles that features hat yai, fragrant Southern Thai-style fried chicken) alongside a variety of more typical Thai restaurant fare. The menu includes the usual suspects of stir-fried noodles and curries, as well as less ubiquitous items like spicy clay pot catfish, and across the board special care and bold seasoning sets the cooking apart. For a case in point, try the hand-made curry puffs, which boast an impeccably delicate, flaky crust....
